candidates.reason: Text block reads well, but the dark card runs flush to the right and top canvas edges with no margin. The can is shrunk to a tiny icon with an unreadable label, and the SOLSTICE wordmark is a few px tall, so the product and brand become trivial. The left column is mostly dead space.

A uniformly shrunk copy of the square original. The subline and the 'Explore Flavours' button text are about 6-7px and barely legible, and the logo wordmark at the top is unreadable. The headline is small for a 300x250 banner, and the canvas is not used for a horizontal layout.

Keeps the can as a real focal point and has a clear headline > subline > CTA order. But the headline and subline stretch nearly edge to edge with tight side margins, the CTA crowds the bottom edge, and the tiny SOLSTICE logo is pushed off-axis to the top right, away from the centred stack.

A clean left/right banner: the card has margins on all sides, and the headline, subline and CTA are well grouped and legible. The can is reduced to a tiny thumbnail with an illegible label, and the logo is tiny, so product and brand presence are weak. The left column feels sparse and unbalanced against the heavy card.
